issues.description: The problem text explicitly instructs students to implement the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public for easier testing, but the UML in the problem statement marks it private ( '-' ), and both the template and the solution implement it as private. This inconsistency between the textual instruction (public) and the UML/template/solution (private) can confuse students about the required visibility and may cause mismatches with tests or grading expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either (A) update the problem statement and UML to state that singFarmSongVerse should be private (and keep the template/solution as-is), or (B) change the template and solution method declaration to public (public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) and adjust the UML to use a '+' to indicate public. Prefer option B if tests expect public access for easier testing.
